whyWeBuiltThis.title: Why We Built OTOX
whyWeBuiltThis.headline: Local transport keeps our cities moving, but trust shouldn't be left to chance.
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph1: Every day, millions of people travel through local transport systems without any verified ride tracking or reliable safety layer. In many situations, passengers have no digital connection to the driver or vehicle once the ride begins.
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph3: Our platform helps create a trusted connection between passengers and drivers using simple QR-based ride verification. Whether it’s a daily commute, a late-night ride, or a quick trip across the city, every ride becomes digitally connected, organized, and easier to manage.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using OTOX as a commuter or partner driver.

items.question: Do I need to book through the app before hailing?
items.answer: No. OTOX respects how you naturally travel. You simply hail an auto on the street as you normally do, get in, and scan the QR code placed inside the vehicle. The app links you instantly without cancellation fees or booking queues.

items.question: Is the app free for passengers?
items.answer: Yes! Passengers can scan, verify their rides, view driver records, and access trip history at absolutely no additional cost.

items.question: How does QR ride verification protect me?
items.answer: Once you scan the QR code, your ride session is securely logged with the vehicle's registration number and the driver's verified background. A digital record is established, making your journey trackable, verifiable, and backed by our safety support team.

items.question: How do I become a verified driver?
items.answer: Drivers can register through the OTOX Driver App or visit any of our local city onboarding centers. Submit your driving license, vehicle registration (RC), and address verification. Once verified, you receive your unique official OTOX QR kit.

items.question: What if there is low network connectivity?
items.answer: OTOX is engineered specifically for real-world Indian mobile connectivity. The QR handshake payload is tiny (under a few kilobytes) and confirms reliably even on 2G/3G connections or fluctuating networks.

items.question: Can I share my live ride status with friends or family?
items.answer: Yes. Immediately upon scanning, you have the option to share a live safety link via WhatsApp or SMS so your loved ones can see your verified driver details and ride status.
